title: Bearing fault diagnosis
summary: A critical replication of an autoencoder and CNN pipeline for motor-current signals.
overview: The project investigates bearing faults using stator-current signals from the Paderborn dataset.
constraints: Changes in operating conditions and differences between individual bearings complicate generalization.
contribution: I developed and investigated the diagnosis pipeline as a university project in electrical machines and drives.
approach: The code implements dataset exploration, preprocessing, autoencoder reconstruction residuals and a one-dimensional CNN. The extended protocol separates entire bearings between training and evaluation.
results: The replication-analysis notebook contains executed comparisons and saved outputs. The extended evaluation notebook contains the protocol and implementation but no saved execution results.
limits: Replication results should not be reported as final performance on unseen bearings. Operating-condition shifts, specimen effects and leakage must be evaluated explicitly.
